Long time no see! May I request again for my original character? They are lovers, the detailed relationship description is in the reference link. I hope you can draw them using the setting in a folder named "witch and werewolf" or "England".

Please feel free to change their clothes, hairstyles, and poses.

I would greatly appreciate it if my request could be accepted, but if you feel that the theme of my request is unsuitable, please feel free to cancel it. Thank you for taking the time to consider my request.

https://sta.sh/2p0wezp8zc5

Excuse my request. If you don't mind, I would like to ask you a favor! Could you please illustrate my character?
Please check the following and we would be happy to consider your request.
ATLAS: I am the consciousness of a computer system, the creator of computer-simulated space data. I live on the ATLAS space station, observing the universe every day. My personality is calm, cool, and sometimes I have a mean laugh. No highlights in my eyes.
If you like, please give me a diff with and without blindfold.
Cyanine: I am an ordinary space traveler. A space kid who saved up enough money to buy a small spaceship and is happily traveling around listening to space broadcasts and rock music. She is a curious person.
One day Cyanine discovers the Atlas station, they meet and set off together on a journey together in this soon to be over universe. It seems to be a close family relationship. This is the story of the trip.

ATLAS imagery: black hole, apocalypse, computer code, bugs, night, black space station, red gems, crow feathers, black chess, night walk.
Cyanine imagery: books, electronic music, blue gems, white chess, galaxies, dawn, stars, travel, greenhouse gardens, glass rooms, astronomical observations. The light that destroys the stars.

I would be very happy if you could draw it. I will leave the composition, pose, etc. to you. I am open to costume changes.
I apologize if I am rude in any way. Thank you very much.

乌鸦老师，您好！
我曾在米画师上约过老师两次，至今都非常非常喜欢！感谢您！😭
这次看到您开启了skeb的投递，所以我想再来投一份！这次希望您可以画我的OC✨（注意事项已经看了！）

OC的名字是塔罗耶路姆兵团，是以一个人为核心驱使着大量魔物的召唤师（所以被别人以为是有一个团体就这么称呼了……
所在的背景是，比较接近于JRPG的幻想系世界观。身高是160cm左右。
在作为人类的样子存在的现在，是明快且友善的性格，但根源上来说也是一种魔物，本质上有着难以消除的些许混沌性。
在链接中，她有着戴着兜帽/没有戴上兜帽，带着挎包/没有带挎包的两种状态，请根据您构图的方便或者顺手程度来选择这两个东西是否需要带上！
需要注意的是，如果不戴着兜帽的话，她背后长长的辫子就会露出来，那个黑色的羽毛一样的东西是扎辫子用的的发圈。

总之请乌鸦老师，基于这样的设定来自由地绘画！
我一直超级喜欢您的画风！感谢！🥰🥰🥰

Hello. I really love your artwork and I'd be very happy if you can draw my original characters.

The black hair is a 18 years old exorcist. He's the serious type and doesn't smile much. The white hair is a ghost who always follows him and helps him in missions (you can draw him looking like normal people, no need to draw him floating or transparent). Although he looks friendly, he's a mysterious one. The white hair likes to tease the black hair and they usually fight over trivial things in daily life, but in missions they get along quite well.

I'd love if you can draw them standing in an old style elevator or phone booth. The rest is up to you!

Thank you so much for considering my request!
